question.question: What reputation counters, starting reputation, five servants, five tiles and ordinary family cards does each player receive, and which families start with money?

fixed_key.expected_answer: Use 1/2, 3/4, 5/6 and Max counters, with 1 showing and marker at position 1; exclude 7/8. Five Available servants: butler, housekeeper, valet, lady’s maid, footman. Five starter-side-up tiles: Private Study, Butler’s Room, Main Gazebo, Front Parlour, Bowling Green. Four family cards: Lord, Lady, Heir, Young Lady; Asquith additionally gets Dowager. Only Ponsonby starts with money (£300).
source_refs: pp.8–10; lines 314–348,361–364; PDF p.9 starter tile images

a.answer: Set reputation to level 1, position 1; stack 1/2, 3/4, 5/6 and Max counters with 1 showing and Max at bottom; do not use 7/8 counters. Each receives butler, housekeeper, valet, lady’s maid and footman in Available Service; Private Study, Butler’s Room, Main Gazebo, Front Parlour and Bowling Green with starter/building icon showing; and Lord, Lady, Heir and Young Lady family cards. Only Ponsonby starts with money (£300).

b.answer: Set reputation to level 1, position 1 (1.1); stack 1/2, 3/4, 5/6 and Max counters with 1 showing and Max at bottom; do not use 7/8 counters. Each player gets one butler, housekeeper, valet, lady’s maid and footman in Available Service; five starting tiles (Private Study, Butler’s Room, Main Gazebo, Front Parlour, Bowling Green) with starter/building icon showing; and Lord, Lady, Heir and Young Lady family cards. Asquith additionally gets Dowager Countess; Ponsonby starts with £300. Other families start with no money (Cavendish bonus is reputation, York’s is a footman).
